round_started.title: Round {round}
round_started.body: A new round begins. Look at the boss and plan your moves together.

phase_planning.title: Phase 1 · Planning
body: The attack against each of you is shown at your seat :damage:.

phase_action.title: Phase 3 · Actions
body: Reveal your curses now, if you have any.
Each hero has [b]3 turns[/b] with one action each, clockwise, starting with [player]{player}[/player].
Heroes with panic :panic: play their hand cards at random, and discard 1 panic token after each.
Show your card to the camera when it is your turn.

phase_attack_blocked.title: Phase 4 · Attack
phase_attack_blocked.body: You blocked everything! [boss]{boss}[/boss] hits nobody this round.

phase_status.title: Phase 5 · Status
body: Poison :poison:: lose [damage]1 health[/damage] :health: per poison token.
Fire :fire:: draw [b]1[/b] :card: per fire token. For each card: remove it for the rest of the fight, [i]or[/i] discard it and lose [damage]2 health[/damage] :health:.

phase_discard.title: Phase 6 · Discard
body: Move the cards from your play area to your discard pile.
Discard down to your hand limit. You may discard more.

phase_draw.title: Phase 7 · Draw
body: Draw up to your hand limit :card:.
Paralysis :paralysis:: your hand limit is [damage]1 lower[/damage] per paralysis token.

support_without_attack.title: No effect
support_without_attack.body: A support only works after a [b]{kind}[/b] attack this round. [player]{player}[/player]'s support does nothing.

heal.body: [player]{player}[/player] heals [heal]{amount} health[/heal] :health:, but not above their starting health.

empowered.body: Until the end of the round, every {kind} of [player]{player}[/player] gets [heal]+{bonus}[/heal].

remove_tokens.body: [player]{player}[/player] removes up to [heal]{count}[/heal] of their own tokens.

mirefang_bite.title: Venomous Bite
mirefang_bite.body: [boss]{boss}[/boss] licks its lips: its attack on [player]{player}[/player] is poisonous :poison:.

defeat.title: Defeat
defeat.body: [boss]{boss}[/boss] has won this time. Rest, and try again!

prompt_choose_starter.body: Who starts this round? [b]Tap a hero.[/b]

prompt_tied_target.body: [boss]{boss}[/boss] cannot decide. [b]Tap the hero it targets.[/b]

prompt_free_play_who.body: [player]{player}[/player] lets another hero play a card for free. [b]Tap who.[/b]

prompt_lucky_charm.body: [player]{player}[/player], show the [b]top card of your draw pile[/b] :card:.

notice_played_already.body: This card is already in play this round.

notice_not_your_card.body: This is not a card of [player]{player}[/player].

notice_used_up.body: [player]{player}[/player] has used this up in this fight.

notice_removed.body: This card is out of the game for the rest of the fight.

take_from_pile.body: [player]{player}[/player] takes [b]{count}[/b] :card: of their choice from their draw pile.

card_removed.body: [player]{player}[/player], put this card back in the box: it is out of the game for the rest of the fight.

attack_effects_removed.body: The attack against [player]{player}[/player] loses its extra effect.

attack_redirected.body: [player]{player}[/player] steps in front of [player]{other}[/player]: the attack of [damage]{damage}[/damage] :damage: now hits [player]{player}[/player].

ward_placed.body: [player]{player}[/player] places [b]{card}[/b] next to their hero card. It can prevent one of the boss's @-abilities against [player]{player}[/player].

ward_ready.body: [b]{card}[/b] of [player]{player}[/player] prevents the boss's next @-ability up to [b]{strength}[/b].

shield_breaker.body: Shield destroyed! [boss]{boss}[/boss] loses [damage]{damage} health[/damage] at once.

prompt_if_healthy.body: Does [player]{player}[/player] now have [b]{health} health[/b] :health: or more?

prompt_chosen_hero.body: [b]Tap the hero[/b] the card of [player]{player}[/player] is for.

prompt_remove_tokens_who.body: [b]Tap the hero[/b] who removes up to [heal]{count}[/heal] tokens.

prompt_redirect_who.body: [b]Tap the hero[/b] whose attack [player]{player}[/player] takes on.

prompt_use_ward.body: [boss]{boss}[/boss] uses an @-ability against [player]{player}[/player]. Discard [b]{card}[/b] to prevent it?

prompt_robot_working.body: Does the battle robot of [player]{player}[/player] still work?

prompt_top_card_or_item.body: [player]{player}[/player], play the [b]top card of your deck[/b] :card: or use Grandpa's Glass Eye.

prompt_attack_or_item.body: [player]{player}[/player], play a hand card with an [b]attack[/b] :card: or use the Water Skin.

notice_still_in_play.body: This card still lies next to the hero card of [player]{player}[/player].

example_magic_potion.title: Magic Potion
example_magic_potion.body: Choose a player to gain [heal]{health} health points[/heal] :health:.

example_reminder.body: [i]Remember:[/i] poisoned heroes lose [damage]1[/damage] :health: at the end of each round.
